author: Jay
name: ShelfarrSignup
short: Request a Shelfarr account from Discord, with admin approval.
description: Members click a button and pick a username. An admin approves the request in a private channel, the bot creates the account through Shelfarr's API with a random password, and DMs the login to the member. Passwords are never stored.
install_msg: Set up with [p]shelfarrsignup channel #approvals and [p]shelfarrsignup loginurl <address>, DM the bot [p]set api shelfarr url <shelfarr url> api_key <token with users:write>, then [p]shelfarrsignup post [#channel].
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs with the Shelfarr username they asked for, while a request is pending and after an account is created. Passwords are never stored.
